name: communicate
description: Register existing Claude and Codex agents on general or named buses, browse the bus interface, message members, and connect devices through scoped HTTPS invitations.

interface.shortDescription: Register agents, browse buses, and message across devices
interface.longDescription: Register the current Claude Code or Codex session on a general or named bus, inspect memberships and availability in a browser interface, send messages with bus membership checks, and invite devices over HTTPS without sharing shell access. Also includes legacy local socket and SSH routing, existing-session Codex queueing, headless Codex conversations, and wake triggers. Ships six skills, the CLI, and MCP tools.
defaultPrompt: Register yourself on the photonics bus
